entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you're speaking with Charlie at VeloFit, agent ID 402. How can I help you today?
Hello... yes, hi. I need to return something. I'm looking at the website, and I'm just so confused by all the policies.
I can certainly help you with a return. To pull up your account, could I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, the name is Sarah Miller, and the order number is... VF7781-9B.

Thank you, Sarah. I see your order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker right here. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band or more of a personal preference?

Oh, it's not broken. It's just... we've had a family emergency. My husband was supposed to go on deployment, but he ended up in the hospital. He needed an unexpected surgery and we've just been dealing with that whole ordeal. I completely missed whatever the return window was. I'm so sorry, I'm just a bit overwhelmed. Can't you just help me?
I am so sorry to hear that, Sarah. That sounds incredibly difficult. Please, don't worry about it. Let me just take a moment to review the policy for you.
Alright, I've pulled up the details here. I can see the VeloBand was delivered to you 34 days ago, on December 20th.
Okay, great news. According to our return policy, you have a full 90 days from the delivery date to return an item. So, you are well within the timeframe.
Oh! 90 days? Really? That's such a relief. I must have misread the website. Thank you so much.
It's no problem at all. I can go ahead and start that return for you right now and email you a prepaid shipping label. You'll receive a full refund once we get the item back at our warehouse.
That would be wonderful. You've really made my day a lot easier, Charlie.
I'm happy I could help. The email with the label is on its way. Is there anything else I can do for you today, Sarah?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. I hope your husband has a swift recovery. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good rest of your day.
